name: Akihito
source:
The former emperor who was supposed to have lost his life in the war.

He has a graceful smile, but also has an unfathomable sense of colour. He has a 'bond' with Ibuki and casts a disturbing shadow over the Imperial Court. Rumour has it that he was born with the power of a curse and that he resents everything in Hinomoto.

Organization: Imperial Court
Interests: Waka, beating the drum (played when Ibuki dances)

[From the website character profile.]
